add:dynamic-fps | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Dynamic FPS | Lowers the frame rate while Minecraft is in the background or minimised, which saves power, reduces heat and frees your PC for other apps. | add dynamic-fps LQ3K71Q1
add:entityculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Entity Culling | Skips drawing mobs, chests and other entities hidden behind walls, which raises FPS in bases, villages and farms. | add entityculling NNAgCjsB
add:ferrite-core | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install FerriteCore | Cuts the memory Minecraft uses for block and model data, which means fewer stutters while the game frees up memory. | add ferrite-core uXXizFIs
add:immediatelyfast | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ImmediatelyFast | Speeds up drawing the HUD, text, items and other on-screen elements, which helps most in busy menus and around lots of signs or name tags. | add immediatelyfast 5ZwdcRci
add:lithium | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Lithium | Speeds up game logic such as mob AI, block ticking and collisions, so your singleplayer world spends less time on each tick. | add lithium gvQqBUqZ
add:modernfix-mvus | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ModernFix-mVUS | Makes the game start faster and use less memory. This is the community build for current Minecraft versions, because the original ModernFix has no release for them. | add modernfix-mvus TjSm1wrD
add:moreculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install More Culling | Skips drawing even more things you can't see, such as hidden leaf faces and item frames, on top of what Sodium and Entity Culling already skip. | add moreculling 51shyZVL
add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX
add:scalablelux | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install ScalableLux | A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build) | add scalablelux Ps1zyz6x
add:asynclogger | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Async Logger | Moves Minecraft's log writing off the main thread and filters noisy log spam, which avoids small stutters from disk I/O. | add asynclogger zvNzKfGF
add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd
add:fastquit | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install FastQuit | Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background. | add fastquit x1hIzbuY
add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm
add:particle-core | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Particle Core | Skips particles you can't see and makes particle-heavy moments like explosions, fireworks and potion effects cheaper to draw. | add particle-core RSeLon5O
add:structure-layout-optimizer | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Structure Layout Optimizer | Speeds up how jigsaw structures like villages, bastions and ancient cities generate, which cuts stutter from worldgen on your singleplayer world's built-in server. | add structure-layout-optimizer ayPU0OHc
set:vanilla.renderDistance | SETTING | HIGH | ticked | Render Distance: 32 → 8 | 10 chunks is a comfortable starting point for mid-range hardware; the benchmark can fine-tune it. With 2 GB or less of memory for Minecraft, more chunks won't fit in memory and cause stutter. | set vanilla.renderDistance 32 -> 8
set:vanilla.improvedTransparency | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Improved Transparency: On → Off | Improved Transparency uses extra screen shaders that cost a lot of GPU time on this hardware. | set vanilla.improvedTransparency true -> false
set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: Unlimited → 60 | Capping the frame rate just below your monitor's refresh rate keeps FreeSync/G-Sync active and avoids rendering frames you can't see, without VSync's input lag. | set vanilla.maxFps 260 -> 60
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 32 → 8 | Simulating up to 8 chunks around you is a good balance for a mid-range CPU. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 32 -> 8
set:vanilla.prioritizeChunkUpdates | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Chunk Builder: Fully Blocking → Threaded | The Threaded chunk builder keeps the frame rate steady when blocks change; the blocking modes can cause frame drops on slower CPUs. | set vanilla.prioritizeChunkUpdates 2 -> 0
set:vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Reduce FPS when: Minimized → AFK | Lowers the frame rate when you're away from the keyboard, which saves battery on a laptop. | set vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit minimized -> afk
advice:laptop-gpu-choice | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Check which graphics chip Minecraft uses | Minecraft is running on integrated graphics. If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none

add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX

add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd

add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm
add:particle-core | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Particle Core | Skips particles you can't see and makes particle-heavy moments like explosions, fireworks and potion effects cheaper to draw. | add particle-core RSeLon5O
add:sodium-extra | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Sodium Extra | Adds extra video options to Sodium, such as turning off individual animations, particles or fog, so you can trade looks for FPS. | add sodium-extra PtjYWJkn
add:structure-layout-optimizer | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Structure Layout Optimizer | Speeds up how jigsaw structures like villages, bastions and ancient cities generate, which cuts stutter from worldgen on your singleplayer world's built-in server. | add structure-layout-optimizer ayPU0OHc

set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: 120 → 60 | Capping the frame rate just below your monitor's refresh rate keeps FreeSync/G-Sync active and avoids rendering frames you can't see, without VSync's input lag. | set vanilla.maxFps 120 -> 60
set:vanilla.cutoutLeaves | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | See-Through Leaves: On → Off | Turning off See-Through Leaves makes forests much cheaper to draw. | set vanilla.cutoutLeaves true -> false
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 12 → 6 | Simulating up to 6 chunks keeps nearby farms working without overloading an entry-level CPU. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 12 -> 6

set:vanilla.renderClouds | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Clouds: Fancy → Off | Turning clouds off saves GPU time on entry-level graphics. | set vanilla.renderClouds true -> false
set:vanilla.entityDistanceScaling | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Distance: 1.0 → 0.75 | Drawing entities slightly closer than normal saves work in busy areas with little visible difference. | set vanilla.entityDistanceScaling 1.0 -> 0.75
set:vanilla.entityShadows | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Shadows: On → Off | Entity shadows cost a little FPS for a small visual touch. | set vanilla.entityShadows true -> false
set:vanilla.particles | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Particles: All → Decreased | Set Particles to Decreased to avoid frame drops during explosions and heavy rain. | set vanilla.particles 0 -> 1
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Soon → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ONE_FRAME -> ALWAYS
set:vanilla.enableVsync | SETTING | LOW | ticked | VSync: On → Off | With the frame-rate cap in place, VSync mostly adds input lag. Turn it back on if you see screen tearing and your monitor has no FreeSync or G-Sync. | set vanilla.enableVsync true -> false
set:vanilla.weatherRadius | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Weather Effect Radius: 10 → 5 | A smaller weather radius draws less rain and snow around you. | set vanilla.weatherRadius 10 -> 5

add:structure-layout-optimizer | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Structure Layout Optimizer | Speeds up how jigsaw structures like villages, bastions and ancient cities generate, which cuts stutter from worldgen on your singleplayer world's built-in server. | add structure-layout-optimizer ayPU0OHc
set:vanilla.renderDistance | SETTING | HIGH | ticked | Render Distance: 32 → 8 | 10 chunks is a comfortable starting point for mid-range hardware; the benchmark can fine-tune it. With 2 GB or less of memory for Minecraft, more chunks won't fit in memory and cause stutter. | set vanilla.renderDistance 32 -> 8
set:vanilla.improvedTransparency | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Improved Transparency: On → Off | Improved Transparency uses extra screen shaders that cost a lot of GPU time on this hardware. | set vanilla.improvedTransparency true -> false
set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: Unlimited → 60 | Capping the frame rate just below your monitor's refresh rate keeps FreeSync/G-Sync active and avoids rendering frames you can't see, without VSync's input lag. | set vanilla.maxFps 260 -> 60
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 32 → 8 | Simulating up to 8 chunks around you is a good balance for a mid-range CPU. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 32 -> 8
set:sodium.performance.use_block_face_culling | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Sodium: Use Block Face Culling: Off → On | Sodium only draws block faces that point towards you, which greatly improves performance; only turn it off if a resource pack shows holes. | set sodium.performance.use_block_face_culling false -> true
set:vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Reduce FPS when: Minimized → AFK | Lowers the frame rate when you're away from the keyboard, which saves battery on a laptop. | set vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit minimized -> afk
set:sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Animate Only Visible Textures: Off → On | Sodium only updates animated textures like water and lava that are on screen. | set sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures false -> true
set:sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads | SETTING | LOW | unticked | Sodium: Chunk Update Threads: 16 → Default | Letting Sodium pick the number of chunk update threads (auto) is right for almost every PC. | set sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads 16 -> 0
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Immediate → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ZERO_FRAMES -> ALWAYS
set:sodium.performance.use_entity_culling | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Entity Culling: Off → On | Sodium skips drawing entities in chunks you can't see. | set sodium.performance.use_entity_culling false -> true
set:sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Fog Occlusion: Off → On | Sodium skips chunks hidden by fog; it's free performance and should stay on. | set sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion false -> true
advice:laptop-gpu-choice | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Check which graphics chip Minecraft uses | Minecraft is running on integrated graphics. If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none

add:dynamic-fps | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Dynamic FPS | Lowers the frame rate while Minecraft is in the background or minimised, which saves power, reduces heat and frees your PC for other apps. | add dynamic-fps LQ3K71Q1

add:lithium | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Lithium | Speeds up game logic such as mob AI, block ticking and collisions, so your singleplayer world spends less time on each tick. | add lithium gvQqBUqZ

add:moreculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install More Culling | Skips drawing even more things you can't see, such as hidden leaf faces and item frames, on top of what Sodium and Entity Culling already skip. | add moreculling 51shyZVL
add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX
add:scalablelux | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install ScalableLux | A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build) | add scalablelux Ps1zyz6x
add:asynclogger | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Async Logger | Moves Minecraft's log writing off the main thread and filters noisy log spam, which avoids small stutters from disk I/O. | add asynclogger zvNzKfGF
add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd
add:fastquit | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install FastQuit | Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background. | add fastquit x1hIzbuY
add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm

set:vanilla.renderDistance | SETTING | HIGH | ticked | Render Distance: 12 → 6 | Your hardware is at the low end, so 6 chunks keeps the frame rate playable; the benchmark can raise it if there's headroom. | set vanilla.renderDistance 12 -> 6
set:vanilla.biomeBlendRadius | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Biome Blend: 5x5 → Off | Turning Biome Blend off makes chunks build faster; biome borders just look sharper. | set vanilla.biomeBlendRadius 2 -> 0
set:vanilla.entityDistanceScaling | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Entity Distance: 1.0 → 0.5 | Drawing mobs and item frames only when they're closer saves a lot of work in busy areas. | set vanilla.entityDistanceScaling 1.0 -> 0.5
set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: 120 → 60 | Capping the frame rate just below your monitor's refresh rate keeps FreeSync/G-Sync active and avoids rendering frames you can't see, without VSync's input lag. | set vanilla.maxFps 120 -> 60
set:vanilla.particles | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Particles: All → Minimal | Set Particles to Minimal: explosions, rain and potion effects stop causing frame drops on weak hardware. | set vanilla.particles 0 -> 2

set:vanilla.entityShadows | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Shadows: On → Off | Entity shadows cost a little FPS for a small visual touch. | set vanilla.entityShadows true -> false

set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Soon → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ONE_FRAME -> ALWAYS

set:vanilla.renderDistance | SETTING | HIGH | ticked | Render Distance: 12 → 8 | 8 chunks is a good balance of view distance and frame rate for entry-level hardware. | set vanilla.renderDistance 12 -> 8
set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: 120 → 60 | Capping the frame rate just below your monitor's refresh rate keeps FreeSync/G-Sync active and avoids rendering frames you can't see, without VSync's input lag. | set vanilla.maxFps 120 -> 60
set:vanilla.cutoutLeaves | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | See-Through Leaves: On → Off | Turning off See-Through Leaves makes forests much cheaper to draw. | set vanilla.cutoutLeaves true -> false
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 12 → 6 | Simulating up to 6 chunks keeps nearby farms working without overloading an entry-level CPU. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 12 -> 6
set:vanilla.biomeBlendRadius | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Biome Blend: 5x5 → 3x3 | A Biome Blend of 3x3 or less builds chunks faster and still smooths biome borders. | set vanilla.biomeBlendRadius 2 -> 1
set:vanilla.renderClouds | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Clouds: Fancy → Off | Turning clouds off saves GPU time on entry-level graphics. | set vanilla.renderClouds true -> false
set:vanilla.entityDistanceScaling | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Distance: 1.0 → 0.75 | Drawing entities slightly closer than normal saves work in busy areas with little visible difference. | set vanilla.entityDistanceScaling 1.0 -> 0.75
set:vanilla.entityShadows | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Shadows: On → Off | Entity shadows cost a little FPS for a small visual touch. | set vanilla.entityShadows true -> false
set:vanilla.particles | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Particles: All → Decreased | Set Particles to Decreased to avoid frame drops during explosions and heavy rain. | set vanilla.particles 0 -> 1
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Soon → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ONE_FRAME -> ALWAYS
set:vanilla.enableVsync | SETTING | LOW | ticked | VSync: On → Off | With the frame-rate cap in place, VSync mostly adds input lag. Turn it back on if you see screen tearing and your monitor has no FreeSync or G-Sync. | set vanilla.enableVsync true -> false
set:vanilla.weatherRadius | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Weather Effect Radius: 10 → 5 | A smaller weather radius draws less rain and snow around you. | set vanilla.weatherRadius 10 -> 5
advice:laptop-gpu-choice | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Check which graphics chip Minecraft uses | Minecraft is running on integrated graphics. If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none

advice:ram-low | WARNING | HIGH | unticked | Give Minecraft more memory | Your launcher lets Minecraft use about 2 GB of memory or less, which causes stutter as the game keeps freeing memory. Set it to at least 4 GB in your launcher's Java or memory settings. | none
add:better-block-entities | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Better Block Entities | Draws chests, signs, beds and similar blocks much more cheaply, which helps a lot in storage rooms and large bases. | add better-block-entities ONZm0H7Y
add:c2me-fabric | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install C2ME | Generates and loads chunks on several CPU cores at once, so new terrain appears faster while you explore. RigTune doesn't also offer Fast Noise or Material Rule Compiler, which conflict with it. (alpha build) | add c2me-fabric VSNURh3q
add:dynamic-fps | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Dynamic FPS | Lowers the frame rate while Minecraft is in the background or minimised, which saves power, reduces heat and frees your PC for other apps. | add dynamic-fps LQ3K71Q1
add:entityculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Entity Culling | Skips drawing mobs, chests and other entities hidden behind walls, which raises FPS in bases, villages and farms. | add entityculling NNAgCjsB
add:ferrite-core | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install FerriteCore | Cuts the memory Minecraft uses for block and model data, which means fewer stutters while the game frees up memory. | add ferrite-core uXXizFIs
add:immediatelyfast | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ImmediatelyFast | Speeds up drawing the HUD, text, items and other on-screen elements, which helps most in busy menus and around lots of signs or name tags. | add immediatelyfast 5ZwdcRci
add:lithium | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Lithium | Speeds up game logic such as mob AI, block ticking and collisions, so your singleplayer world spends less time on each tick. | add lithium gvQqBUqZ
add:modernfix-mvus | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ModernFix-mVUS | Makes the game start faster and use less memory. This is the community build for current Minecraft versions, because the original ModernFix has no release for them. | add modernfix-mvus TjSm1wrD
add:moreculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install More Culling | Skips drawing even more things you can't see, such as hidden leaf faces and item frames, on top of what Sodium and Entity Culling already skip. | add moreculling 51shyZVL
add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX
add:scalablelux | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install ScalableLux | A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build) | add scalablelux Ps1zyz6x
add:asynclogger | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Async Logger | Moves Minecraft's log writing off the main thread and filters noisy log spam, which avoids small stutters from disk I/O. | add asynclogger zvNzKfGF
add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd
add:fastquit | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install FastQuit | Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background. | add fastquit x1hIzbuY
add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm
add:particle-core | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Particle Core | Skips particles you can't see and makes particle-heavy moments like explosions, fireworks and potion effects cheaper to draw. | add particle-core RSeLon5O
add:sodium-extra | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Sodium Extra | Adds extra video options to Sodium, such as turning off individual animations, particles or fog, so you can trade looks for FPS. | add sodium-extra PtjYWJkn

set:sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Fog Occlusion: Off → On | Sodium skips chunks hidden by fog; it's free performance and should stay on. | set sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion false -> true

set:sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Fog Occlusion: Off → On | Sodium skips chunks hidden by fog; it's free performance and should stay on. | set sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion false -> true

add:lithium | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Lithium | Speeds up game logic such as mob AI, block ticking and collisions, so your singleplayer world spends less time on each tick. | add lithium gvQqBUqZ

add:moreculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install More Culling | Skips drawing even more things you can't see, such as hidden leaf faces and item frames, on top of what Sodium and Entity Culling already skip. | add moreculling 51shyZVL
add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX
add:scalablelux | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install ScalableLux | A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build) | add scalablelux Ps1zyz6x
add:asynclogger | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Async Logger | Moves Minecraft's log writing off the main thread and filters noisy log spam, which avoids small stutters from disk I/O. | add asynclogger zvNzKfGF
add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd
add:fastquit | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install FastQuit | Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background. | add fastquit x1hIzbuY
add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm
add:particle-core | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Particle Core | Skips particles you can't see and makes particle-heavy moments like explosions, fireworks and potion effects cheaper to draw. | add particle-core RSeLon5O
add:sodium-extra | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Sodium Extra | Adds extra video options to Sodium, such as turning off individual animations, particles or fog, so you can trade looks for FPS. | add sodium-extra PtjYWJkn
add:structure-layout-optimizer | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Structure Layout Optimizer | Speeds up how jigsaw structures like villages, bastions and ancient cities generate, which cuts stutter from worldgen on your singleplayer world's built-in server. | add structure-layout-optimizer ayPU0OHc

A community Distant Horizons guide (distanthorizonsguide.com) suggests 64 to 96 chunks for entry-level PCs; on low-end hardware RigTune caps it lower, at 48. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.lodChunkRenderDistanceRadius 256 -> 48

Distant overhangs and caves look simpler. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.verticalQuality MEDIUM -> LOW

set:vanilla.particles | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Particles: All → Minimal | Set Particles to Minimal: explosions, rain and potion effects stop causing frame drops on weak hardware. | set vanilla.particles 0 -> 2

Lowest is what Distant Horizons' own Minimum quality preset uses (its default is Medium), and its description says higher settings use more memory and GPU time. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.horizontalQuality MEDIUM -> LOWEST

set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Soon → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ONE_FRAME -> ALWAYS

add:c2me-fabric | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install C2ME | Generates and loads chunks on several CPU cores at once, so new terrain appears faster while you explore. RigTune doesn't also offer Fast Noise or Material Rule Compiler, which conflict with it. (alpha build) | add c2me-fabric VSNURh3q
add:dynamic-fps | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Dynamic FPS | Lowers the frame rate while Minecraft is in the background or minimised, which saves power, reduces heat and frees your PC for other apps. | add dynamic-fps LQ3K71Q1
add:entityculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Entity Culling | Skips drawing mobs, chests and other entities hidden behind walls, which raises FPS in bases, villages and farms. | add entityculling NNAgCjsB
add:ferrite-core | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install FerriteCore | Cuts the memory Minecraft uses for block and model data, which means fewer stutters while the game frees up memory. | add ferrite-core uXXizFIs
add:immediatelyfast | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ImmediatelyFast | Speeds up drawing the HUD, text, items and other on-screen elements, which helps most in busy menus and around lots of signs or name tags. | add immediatelyfast 5ZwdcRci
add:lithium | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Lithium | Speeds up game logic such as mob AI, block ticking and collisions, so your singleplayer world spends less time on each tick. | add lithium gvQqBUqZ
add:modernfix-mvus | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ModernFix-mVUS | Makes the game start faster and use less memory. This is the community build for current Minecraft versions, because the original ModernFix has no release for them. | add modernfix-mvus TjSm1wrD
add:moreculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install More Culling | Skips drawing even more things you can't see, such as hidden leaf faces and item frames, on top of what Sodium and Entity Culling already skip. | add moreculling 51shyZVL
add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX
add:scalablelux | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install ScalableLux | A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build) | add scalablelux Ps1zyz6x
add:asynclogger | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Async Logger | Moves Minecraft's log writing off the main thread and filters noisy log spam, which avoids small stutters from disk I/O. | add asynclogger zvNzKfGF
add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd
add:fastquit | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install FastQuit | Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background. | add fastquit x1hIzbuY
add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm
add:particle-core | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Particle Core | Skips particles you can't see and makes particle-heavy moments like explosions, fireworks and potion effects cheaper to draw. | add particle-core RSeLon5O
add:sodium-extra | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Sodium Extra | Adds extra video options to Sodium, such as turning off individual animations, particles or fog, so you can trade looks for FPS. | add sodium-extra PtjYWJkn
add:structure-layout-optimizer | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Structure Layout Optimizer | Speeds up how jigsaw structures like villages, bastions and ancient cities generate, which cuts stutter from worldgen on your singleplayer world's built-in server. | add structure-layout-optimizer ayPU0OHc
set:vanilla.renderDistance | SETTING | HIGH | ticked | Render Distance: 32 → 8 | 10 chunks is a comfortable starting point for mid-range hardware; the benchmark can fine-tune it. With 2 GB or less of memory for Minecraft, more chunks won't fit in memory and cause stutter. | set vanilla.renderDistance 32 -> 8
set:dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.lodChunkRenderDistanceRadius | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Distant Horizons: LOD Chunk Render Distance Radius: 512 → 96 | Distant Horizons' far terrain still costs memory and GPU time, more so the further it reaches (its default is 256 chunks). A community Distant Horizons guide (distanthorizonsguide.com) suggests 96 to 128 chunks for mid-range PCs; RigTune caps it at 96. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.lodChunkRenderDistanceRadius 512 -> 96
set:vanilla.improvedTransparency | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Improved Transparency: On → Off | Improved Transparency uses extra screen shaders that cost a lot of GPU time on this hardware. | set vanilla.improvedTransparency true -> false
set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: Unlimited → 60 | Capping the frame rate just below your monitor's refresh rate keeps FreeSync/G-Sync active and avoids rendering frames you can't see, without VSync's input lag. | set vanilla.maxFps 260 -> 60
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 32 → 8 | Simulating up to 8 chunks around you is a good balance for a mid-range CPU. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 32 -> 8
set:sodium.performance.use_block_face_culling | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Sodium: Use Block Face Culling: Off → On | Sodium only draws block faces that point towards you, which greatly improves performance; only turn it off if a resource pack shows holes. | set sodium.performance.use_block_face_culling false -> true
set:dh.common.multiThreading.numberOfThreads | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Distant Horizons: NO. of threads: 16 → 4 | Distant Horizons uses half of your CPU threads by default. On a CPU this size, more than 4 Distant Horizons threads compete with Minecraft itself and can cause stutter while far terrain loads. | set dh.common.multiThreading.numberOfThreads 16 -> 4
set:vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Reduce FPS when: Minimized → AFK | Lowers the frame rate when you're away from the keyboard, which saves battery on a laptop. | set vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit minimized -> afk
set:sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Animate Only Visible Textures: Off → On | Sodium only updates animated textures like water and lava that are on screen. | set sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures false -> true
set:sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads | SETTING | LOW | unticked | Sodium: Chunk Update Threads: 16 → Default | Letting Sodium pick the number of chunk update threads (auto) is right for almost every PC. | set sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads 16 -> 0
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Immediate → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ZERO_FRAMES -> ALWAYS
set:sodium.performance.use_entity_culling | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Entity Culling: Off → On | Sodium skips drawing entities in chunks you can't see. | set sodium.performance.use_entity_culling false -> true
set:sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Fog Occlusion: Off → On | Sodium skips chunks hidden by fog; it's free performance and should stay on. | set sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion false -> true
advice:laptop-gpu-choice | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Check which graphics chip Minecraft uses | Minecraft is running on integrated graphics. If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none
advice:ram-distant-horizons-low-system | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Distant Horizons on a PC with little RAM | Per its FAQ, Distant Horizons needs roughly 2 to 4 GB more memory than vanilla, but this PC has less than 12 GB of RAM, so give Minecraft about 4 GB at most. Keep Distant Horizons' render distance short instead, and close other apps while you play. | none

A community Distant Horizons guide (distanthorizonsguide.com) suggests 64 to 96 chunks for entry-level PCs; on low-end hardware RigTune caps it lower, at 48. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.lodChunkRenderDistanceRadius 256 -> 48
set:vanilla.renderDistance | SETTING | HIGH | ticked | Render Distance: 12 → 6 | Your hardware is at the low end, so 6 chunks keeps the frame rate playable; the benchmark can raise it if there's headroom. | set vanilla.renderDistance 12 -> 6
set:vanilla.biomeBlendRadius | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Biome Blend: 5x5 → Off | Turning Biome Blend off makes chunks build faster; biome borders just look sharper. | set vanilla.biomeBlendRadius 2 -> 0
set:dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.maxHorizontalResolution | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Distant Horizons: Max Horizontal Resolution: Block → 2 blocks | 2 blocks is the maximum far-terrain resolution Distant Horizons' own Minimum quality preset uses; every other preset uses Block, its default, which its description says costs more memory and GPU time. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.maxHorizontalResolution BLOCK -> TWO_BLOCKS
set:dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.verticalQuality | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Distant Horizons: Vertical Quality: Medium → Low | Low is the vertical quality Distant Horizons' own Low quality preset uses (its default is Medium), and its description says higher settings use more memory and GPU time. Distant overhangs and caves look simpler. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.verticalQuality MEDIUM -> LOW
set:vanilla.entityDistanceScaling | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Entity Distance: 1.0 → 0.5 | Drawing mobs and item frames only when they're closer saves a lot of work in busy areas. | set vanilla.entityDistanceScaling 1.0 -> 0.5
set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: 120 → 60 | Capping the frame rate just below your monitor's refresh rate keeps FreeSync/G-Sync active and avoids rendering frames you can't see, without VSync's input lag. | set vanilla.maxFps 120 -> 60
set:vanilla.particles | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Particles: All → Minimal | Set Particles to Minimal: explosions, rain and potion effects stop causing frame drops on weak hardware. | set vanilla.particles 0 -> 2
set:vanilla.cutoutLeaves | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | See-Through Leaves: On → Off | Turning off See-Through Leaves makes forests much cheaper to draw. | set vanilla.cutoutLeaves true -> false
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 12 → 5 | A short simulation distance means fewer mobs, crops and redstone for your CPU to update each tick. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 12 -> 5
set:vanilla.renderClouds | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Clouds: Fancy → Off | Turning clouds off saves GPU time on entry-level graphics. | set vanilla.renderClouds true -> false
set:dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.horizontalQuality | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Distant Horizons: LOD Dropoff Distance: Medium → Lowest | The LOD dropoff distance sets how soon far terrain loses detail. Lowest is what Distant Horizons' own Minimum quality preset uses (its default is Medium), and its description says higher settings use more memory and GPU time. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.horizontalQuality MEDIUM -> LOWEST
set:vanilla.entityShadows | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Shadows: On → Off | Entity shadows cost a little FPS for a small visual touch. | set vanilla.entityShadows true -> false
set:sodium.performance.quad_splitting_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Block Transparency Limits: Safe → Basic | Skipping Sodium's extra work for overlapping see-through blocks (like waterlogged glass panes) helps very weak GPUs; those blocks may look slightly wrong. | set sodium.performance.quad_splitting_mode SAFE -> OFF
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Soon → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ONE_FRAME -> ALWAYS
set:vanilla.enableVsync | SETTING | LOW | ticked | VSync: On → Off | With the frame-rate cap in place, VSync mostly adds input lag. Turn it back on if you see screen tearing and your monitor has no FreeSync or G-Sync. | set vanilla.enableVsync true -> false
set:vanilla.weatherRadius | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Weather Effect Radius: 10 → 5 | A smaller weather radius draws less rain and snow around you. | set vanilla.weatherRadius 10 -> 5

set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 32 → 5 | A short simulation distance means fewer mobs, crops and redstone for your CPU to update each tick. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 32 -> 5
set:sodium.performance.use_block_face_culling | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Sodium: Use Block Face Culling: Off → On | Sodium only draws block faces that point towards you, which greatly improves performance; only turn it off if a resource pack shows holes. | set sodium.performance.use_block_face_culling false -> true
set:vanilla.renderClouds | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Clouds: Fancy → Off | Turning clouds off saves GPU time on entry-level graphics. | set vanilla.renderClouds true -> false
set:dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.horizontalQuality | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Distant Horizons: LOD Dropoff Distance: Extreme → Lowest | The LOD dropoff distance sets how soon far terrain loses detail. Lowest is what Distant Horizons' own Minimum quality preset uses (its default is Medium), and its description says higher settings use more memory and GPU time. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.horizontalQuality EXTREME -> LOWEST
set:dh.common.multiThreading.numberOfThreads | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Distant Horizons: NO. of threads: 16 → 4 | Distant Horizons uses half of your CPU threads by default. On a CPU this size, more than 4 Distant Horizons threads compete with Minecraft itself and can cause stutter while far terrain loads. | set dh.common.multiThreading.numberOfThreads 16 -> 4
set:vanilla.entityShadows | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Shadows: On → Off | Entity shadows cost a little FPS for a small visual touch. | set vanilla.entityShadows true -> false
set:vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Reduce FPS when: Minimized → AFK | Lowers the frame rate when you're away from the keyboard, which saves battery on a laptop. | set vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit minimized -> afk
set:sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Animate Only Visible Textures: Off → On | Sodium only updates animated textures like water and lava that are on screen. | set sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures false -> true
set:sodium.performance.quad_splitting_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Block Transparency Limits: Unlimited → Basic | Skipping Sodium's extra work for overlapping see-through blocks (like waterlogged glass panes) helps very weak GPUs; those blocks may look slightly wrong. | set sodium.performance.quad_splitting_mode UNLIMITED -> OFF
set:sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads | SETTING | LOW | unticked | Sodium: Chunk Update Threads: 16 → Default | Letting Sodium pick the number of chunk update threads (auto) is right for almost every PC. | set sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads 16 -> 0
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Immediate → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ZERO_FRAMES -> ALWAYS
set:sodium.performance.use_entity_culling | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Entity Culling: Off → On | Sodium skips drawing entities in chunks you can't see. | set sodium.performance.use_entity_culling false -> true
set:sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Fog Occlusion: Off → On | Sodium skips chunks hidden by fog; it's free performance and should stay on. | set sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion false -> true
set:vanilla.textureFiltering | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Texture Filtering: Anisotropic → None | Set Texture Filtering to None: RGSS and Anisotropic filtering cost GPU time and video memory that weaker graphics can't spare. | set vanilla.textureFiltering 2 -> 0
set:vanilla.weatherRadius | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Weather Effect Radius: 10 → 5 | A smaller weather radius draws less rain and snow around you. | set vanilla.weatherRadius 10 -> 5
advice:laptop-gpu-choice | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Check which graphics chip Minecraft uses | Minecraft is running on integrated graphics. If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none
advice:ram-distant-horizons-low-system | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Distant Horizons on a PC with little RAM | Per its FAQ, Distant Horizons needs roughly 2 to 4 GB more memory than vanilla, but this PC has less than 12 GB of RAM, so give Minecraft about 4 GB at most. Keep Distant Horizons' render distance short instead, and close other apps while you play. | none

advice:ram-low | WARNING | HIGH | unticked | Give Minecraft more memory | Your launcher lets Minecraft use about 2 GB of memory or less, which causes stutter as the game keeps freeing memory. Set it to at least 4 GB in your launcher's Java or memory settings. | none
add:better-block-entities | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Better Block Entities | Draws chests, signs, beds and similar blocks much more cheaply, which helps a lot in storage rooms and large bases. | add better-block-entities ONZm0H7Y
add:c2me-fabric | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install C2ME | Generates and loads chunks on several CPU cores at once, so new terrain appears faster while you explore. RigTune doesn't also offer Fast Noise or Material Rule Compiler, which conflict with it. (alpha build) | add c2me-fabric VSNURh3q
add:dynamic-fps | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Dynamic FPS | Lowers the frame rate while Minecraft is in the background or minimised, which saves power, reduces heat and frees your PC for other apps. | add dynamic-fps LQ3K71Q1
add:entityculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Entity Culling | Skips drawing mobs, chests and other entities hidden behind walls, which raises FPS in bases, villages and farms. | add entityculling NNAgCjsB
add:ferrite-core | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install FerriteCore | Cuts the memory Minecraft uses for block and model data, which means fewer stutters while the game frees up memory. | add ferrite-core uXXizFIs
add:immediatelyfast | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ImmediatelyFast | Speeds up drawing the HUD, text, items and other on-screen elements, which helps most in busy menus and around lots of signs or name tags. | add immediatelyfast 5ZwdcRci
add:lithium | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Lithium | Speeds up game logic such as mob AI, block ticking and collisions, so your singleplayer world spends less time on each tick. | add lithium gvQqBUqZ
add:modernfix-mvus | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ModernFix-mVUS | Makes the game start faster and use less memory. This is the community build for current Minecraft versions, because the original ModernFix has no release for them. | add modernfix-mvus TjSm1wrD
add:moreculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install More Culling | Skips drawing even more things you can't see, such as hidden leaf faces and item frames, on top of what Sodium and Entity Culling already skip. | add moreculling 51shyZVL
add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX
add:scalablelux | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install ScalableLux | A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build) | add scalablelux Ps1zyz6x
add:asynclogger | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Async Logger | Moves Minecraft's log writing off the main thread and filters noisy log spam, which avoids small stutters from disk I/O. | add asynclogger zvNzKfGF
add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd
add:fastquit | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install FastQuit | Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background. | add fastquit x1hIzbuY
add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm
add:particle-core | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Particle Core | Skips particles you can't see and makes particle-heavy moments like explosions, fireworks and potion effects cheaper to draw. | add particle-core RSeLon5O

add:better-block-entities | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Better Block Entities | Draws chests, signs, beds and similar blocks much more cheaply, which helps a lot in storage rooms and large bases. | add better-block-entities ONZm0H7Y
add:c2me-fabric | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install C2ME | Generates and loads chunks on several CPU cores at once, so new terrain appears faster while you explore. RigTune doesn't also offer Fast Noise or Material Rule Compiler, which conflict with it. (alpha build) | add c2me-fabric VSNURh3q
add:dynamic-fps | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Dynamic FPS | Lowers the frame rate while Minecraft is in the background or minimised, which saves power, reduces heat and frees your PC for other apps. | add dynamic-fps LQ3K71Q1
add:entityculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Entity Culling | Skips drawing mobs, chests and other entities hidden behind walls, which raises FPS in bases, villages and farms. | add entityculling NNAgCjsB
add:ferrite-core | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install FerriteCore | Cuts the memory Minecraft uses for block and model data, which means fewer stutters while the game frees up memory. | add ferrite-core uXXizFIs
add:immediatelyfast | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ImmediatelyFast | Speeds up drawing the HUD, text, items and other on-screen elements, which helps most in busy menus and around lots of signs or name tags. | add immediatelyfast 5ZwdcRci
add:lithium | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install Lithium | Speeds up game logic such as mob AI, block ticking and collisions, so your singleplayer world spends less time on each tick. | add lithium gvQqBUqZ
add:modernfix-mvus | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install ModernFix-mVUS | Makes the game start faster and use less memory. This is the community build for current Minecraft versions, because the original ModernFix has no release for them. | add modernfix-mvus TjSm1wrD
add:moreculling | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | ticked | Install More Culling | Skips drawing even more things you can't see, such as hidden leaf faces and item frames, on top of what Sodium and Entity Culling already skip. | add moreculling 51shyZVL
add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX
add:scalablelux | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install ScalableLux | A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build) | add scalablelux Ps1zyz6x
add:asynclogger | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Async Logger | Moves Minecraft's log writing off the main thread and filters noisy log spam, which avoids small stutters from disk I/O. | add asynclogger zvNzKfGF
add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd
add:fastquit | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install FastQuit | Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background. | add fastquit x1hIzbuY
add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm
add:particle-core | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Particle Core | Skips particles you can't see and makes particle-heavy moments like explosions, fireworks and potion effects cheaper to draw. | add particle-core RSeLon5O
add:sodium-extra | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Sodium Extra | Adds extra video options to Sodium, such as turning off individual animations, particles or fog, so you can trade looks for FPS. | add sodium-extra PtjYWJkn
add:structure-layout-optimizer | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Structure Layout Optimizer | Speeds up how jigsaw structures like villages, bastions and ancient cities generate, which cuts stutter from worldgen on your singleplayer world's built-in server. | add structure-layout-optimizer ayPU0OHc
set:vanilla.renderDistance | SETTING | HIGH | ticked | Render Distance: 12 → 8 | 10 chunks is a comfortable starting point for mid-range hardware; the benchmark can fine-tune it. With 2 GB or less of memory for Minecraft, more chunks won't fit in memory and cause stutter. | set vanilla.renderDistance 12 -> 8
set:dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.lodChunkRenderDistanceRadius | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Distant Horizons: LOD Chunk Render Distance Radius: 256 → 96 | Distant Horizons' far terrain still costs memory and GPU time, more so the further it reaches (its default is 256 chunks). A community Distant Horizons guide (distanthorizonsguide.com) suggests 96 to 128 chunks for mid-range PCs; RigTune caps it at 96. | set dh.client.advanced.graphics.quality.lodChunkRenderDistanceRadius 256 -> 96
set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: 120 → 60 | Capping the frame rate just below your monitor's refresh rate keeps FreeSync/G-Sync active and avoids rendering frames you can't see, without VSync's input lag. | set vanilla.maxFps 120 -> 60
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 12 → 8 | Simulating up to 8 chunks around you is a good balance for a mid-range CPU. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 12 -> 8
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Soon → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ONE_FRAME -> ALWAYS
set:vanilla.enableVsync | SETTING | LOW | ticked | VSync: On → Off | With the frame-rate cap in place, VSync mostly adds input lag. Turn it back on if you see screen tearing and your monitor has no FreeSync or G-Sync. | set vanilla.enableVsync true -> false
advice:laptop-gpu-choice | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Check which graphics chip Minecraft uses | Minecraft is running on integrated graphics. If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none
advice:ram-distant-horizons-low-system | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Distant Horizons on a PC with little RAM | Per its FAQ, Distant Horizons needs roughly 2 to 4 GB more memory than vanilla, but this PC has less than 12 GB of RAM, so give Minecraft about 4 GB at most. Keep Distant Horizons' render distance short instead, and close other apps while you play. | none

On a CPU this size, more than 4 Distant Horizons threads compete with Minecraft itself and can cause stutter while far terrain loads. | set dh.common.multiThreading.numberOfThreads 16 -> 4
set:vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Reduce FPS when: Minimized → AFK | Lowers the frame rate when you're away from the keyboard, which saves battery on a laptop. | set vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit minimized -> afk
set:sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Animate Only Visible Textures: Off → On | Sodium only updates animated textures like water and lava that are on screen. | set sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures false -> true
set:sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads | SETTING | LOW | unticked | Sodium: Chunk Update Threads: 16 → Default | Letting Sodium pick the number of chunk update threads (auto) is right for almost every PC. | set sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads 16 -> 0
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Immediate → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ZERO_FRAMES -> ALWAYS
set:sodium.performance.use_entity_culling | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Entity Culling: Off → On | Sodium skips drawing entities in chunks you can't see. | set sodium.performance.use_entity_culling false -> true
set:sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Fog Occlusion: Off → On | Sodium skips chunks hidden by fog; it's free performance and should stay on. | set sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion false -> true

add:scalablelux | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install ScalableLux | A faster lighting engine based on Starlight, so loading chunks and changing blocks costs less CPU time. (alpha build) | add scalablelux Ps1zyz6x

add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. It isn't part of the popular optimisation modpacks, so it starts unticked. | add badoptimizations g96Z4WVZ
add:debugify | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Debugify | Fixes a long list of known vanilla bugs. Only a few affect performance, so it starts unticked. | add debugify QwxR6Gcd
add:fastquit | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install FastQuit | Takes you back to the title screen straight away while your world finishes saving in the background. | add fastquit x1hIzbuY
add:ixeris | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Ixeris | Handles window and input events on a separate thread, which can smooth out frame times. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm
add:particle-core | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Particle Core | Skips particles you can't see and makes particle-heavy moments like explosions, fireworks and potion effects cheaper to draw. | add particle-core RSeLon5O
add:structure-layout-optimizer | ADD_MOD | LOW | ticked | Install Structure Layout Optimizer | Speeds up how jigsaw structures like villages, bastions and ancient cities generate, which cuts stutter from worldgen on your singleplayer world's built-in server. | add structure-layout-optimizer ayPU0OHc
set:vanilla.renderDistance | SETTING | HIGH | ticked | Render Distance: 32 → 6 | Your hardware is at the low end, so 6 chunks keeps the frame rate playable; the benchmark can raise it if there's headroom. | set vanilla.renderDistance 32 -> 6
set:vanilla.biomeBlendRadius | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Biome Blend: 15x15 → Off | Turning Biome Blend off makes chunks build faster; biome borders just look sharper. | set vanilla.biomeBlendRadius 7 -> 0
set:vanilla.entityDistanceScaling | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Entity Distance: 5.0 → 0.5 | Drawing mobs and item frames only when they're closer saves a lot of work in busy areas. | set vanilla.entityDistanceScaling 5.0 -> 0.5
set:vanilla.improvedTransparency | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Improved Transparency: On → Off | Improved Transparency uses extra screen shaders that cost a lot of GPU time on this hardware. | set vanilla.improvedTransparency true -> false
set:vanilla.maxFps | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Max Framerate: Unlimited → 60 | On battery, capping at 60 FPS cuts the work your GPU does and makes the battery last noticeably longer. | set vanilla.maxFps 260 -> 60
set:vanilla.particles | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Particles: All → Minimal | Set Particles to Minimal: explosions, rain and potion effects stop causing frame drops on weak hardware. | set vanilla.particles 0 -> 2
set:vanilla.cutoutLeaves | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | See-Through Leaves: On → Off | Turning off See-Through Leaves makes forests much cheaper to draw. | set vanilla.cutoutLeaves true -> false
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 32 → 5 | A short simulation distance means fewer mobs, crops and redstone for your CPU to update each tick. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 32 -> 5
set:vanilla.prioritizeChunkUpdates | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Chunk Builder: Fully Blocking → Threaded | The Threaded chunk builder keeps the frame rate steady when blocks change; the blocking modes can cause frame drops on slower CPUs. | set vanilla.prioritizeChunkUpdates 2 -> 0
set:vanilla.renderClouds | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Clouds: Fancy → Off | Turning clouds off saves GPU time on entry-level graphics. | set vanilla.renderClouds true -> false
set:vanilla.entityShadows | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Shadows: On → Off | Entity shadows cost a little FPS for a small visual touch. | set vanilla.entityShadows true -> false
set:vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Reduce FPS when: Minimized → AFK | Lowers the frame rate when you're away from the keyboard, which saves battery on a laptop. | set vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit minimized -> afk
set:vanilla.textureFiltering | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Texture Filtering: Anisotropic → None | Set Texture Filtering to None: RGSS and Anisotropic filtering cost GPU time and video memory that weaker graphics can't spare. | set vanilla.textureFiltering 2 -> 0
set:vanilla.enableVsync | SETTING | LOW | ticked | VSync: Off → On | On battery, VSync stops the GPU drawing frames your screen can't show, which saves power. | set vanilla.enableVsync false -> true
set:vanilla.weatherRadius | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Weather Effect Radius: 10 → 5 | A smaller weather radius draws less rain and snow around you. | set vanilla.weatherRadius 10 -> 5
advice:laptop-gpu-choice | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Check which graphics chip Minecraft uses | Minecraft is running on integrated graphics. If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none
advice:battery | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Running on battery | Laptops slow down the CPU and GPU on battery to save power, so expect lower FPS. Plug in for full performance, or keep RigTune's battery-saving settings. | none

set:sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Animate Only Visible Textures: Off → On | Sodium only updates animated textures like water and lava that are on screen. | set sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures false -> true
set:sodium.performance.quad_splitting_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Block Transparency Limits: Unlimited → Basic | Skipping Sodium's extra work for overlapping see-through blocks (like waterlogged glass panes) helps very weak GPUs; those blocks may look slightly wrong. | set sodium.performance.quad_splitting_mode UNLIMITED -> OFF
set:sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads | SETTING | LOW | unticked | Sodium: Chunk Update Threads: 16 → Default | Letting Sodium pick the number of chunk update threads (auto) is right for almost every PC. | set sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads 16 -> 0
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Immediate → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ZERO_FRAMES -> ALWAYS
set:sodium.performance.use_entity_culling | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Entity Culling: Off → On | Sodium skips drawing entities in chunks you can't see. | set sodium.performance.use_entity_culling false -> true
set:sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Fog Occlusion: Off → On | Sodium skips chunks hidden by fog; it's free performance and should stay on. | set sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion false -> true
set:vanilla.textureFiltering | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Texture Filtering: Anisotropic → None | Set Texture Filtering to None: RGSS and Anisotropic filtering cost GPU time and video memory that weaker graphics can't spare. | set vanilla.textureFiltering 2 -> 0
set:vanilla.enableVsync | SETTING | LOW | ticked | VSync: Off → On | On battery, VSync stops the GPU drawing frames your screen can't show, which saves power. | set vanilla.enableVsync false -> true
set:vanilla.weatherRadius | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Weather Effect Radius: 10 → 5 | A smaller weather radius draws less rain and snow around you. | set vanilla.weatherRadius 10 -> 5

If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none
advice:battery | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Running on battery | Laptops slow down the CPU and GPU on battery to save power, so expect lower FPS. Plug in for full performance, or keep RigTune's battery-saving settings. | none

add:renderscale | ADD_MOD | MEDIUM | unticked | Install RenderScale | Renders the game at a lower internal resolution and upscales it, which cuts GPU work on weak or integrated graphics, or on a mid-range graphics card driving a 1440p or larger screen, at the cost of some sharpness. | add renderscale Va8PJBFX

add:badoptimizations | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install BadOptimizations | A set of small client-side optimisations, such as skipping lighting and sky-colour updates when nothing has changed. On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC
add:krypton | ADD_MOD | LOW | unticked | Install Krypton | Optimises Minecraft's networking code. The gain on your side is small and mostly shows on busy multiplayer servers. | add krypton fQEb0iXm

On Windows it also reads raw mouse input in batches, which helps most with a high-polling-rate mouse; per its changelog, that part isn't ported to Minecraft 26.3's new SDL window system yet, so the gain there is smaller. | add ixeris p8RJPJIC

set:vanilla.particles | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Particles: All → Minimal | Set Particles to Minimal: explosions, rain and potion effects stop causing frame drops on weak hardware. | set vanilla.particles 0 -> 2
set:vanilla.cutoutLeaves | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | See-Through Leaves: On → Off | Turning off See-Through Leaves makes forests much cheaper to draw. | set vanilla.cutoutLeaves true -> false
set:vanilla.simulationDistance | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Simulation Distance: 32 → 5 | A short simulation distance means fewer mobs, crops and redstone for your CPU to update each tick. | set vanilla.simulationDistance 32 -> 5
set:sodium.performance.use_block_face_culling | SETTING | MEDIUM | ticked | Sodium: Use Block Face Culling: Off → On | Sodium only draws block faces that point towards you, which greatly improves performance; only turn it off if a resource pack shows holes. | set sodium.performance.use_block_face_culling false -> true
set:vanilla.renderClouds | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Clouds: Fancy → Off | Turning clouds off saves GPU time on entry-level graphics. | set vanilla.renderClouds true -> false
set:vanilla.entityShadows | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Entity Shadows: On → Off | Entity shadows cost a little FPS for a small visual touch. | set vanilla.entityShadows true -> false
set:vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Reduce FPS when: Minimized → AFK | Lowers the frame rate when you're away from the keyboard, which saves battery on a laptop. | set vanilla.inactivityFpsLimit minimized -> afk
set:sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Animate Only Visible Textures: Off → On | Sodium only updates animated textures like water and lava that are on screen. | set sodium.performance.animate_only_visible_textures false -> true
set:sodium.performance.quad_splitting_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Block Transparency Limits: Unlimited → Basic | Skipping Sodium's extra work for overlapping see-through blocks (like waterlogged glass panes) helps very weak GPUs; those blocks may look slightly wrong. | set sodium.performance.quad_splitting_mode UNLIMITED -> OFF
set:sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads | SETTING | LOW | unticked | Sodium: Chunk Update Threads: 16 → Default | Letting Sodium pick the number of chunk update threads (auto) is right for almost every PC. | set sodium.performance.chunk_builder_threads 16 -> 0
set:sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Chunk Updates: Immediate → Deferred | Deferred chunk updates never make a frame wait for chunk building, which gives the highest FPS; blocks may take a moment to appear. | set sodium.performance.chunk_build_defer_mode ZERO_FRAMES -> ALWAYS
set:sodium.performance.use_entity_culling | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Entity Culling: Off → On | Sodium skips drawing entities in chunks you can't see. | set sodium.performance.use_entity_culling false -> true
set:sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Sodium: Use Fog Occlusion: Off → On | Sodium skips chunks hidden by fog; it's free performance and should stay on. | set sodium.performance.use_fog_occlusion false -> true
set:vanilla.textureFiltering | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Texture Filtering: Anisotropic → None | Set Texture Filtering to None: RGSS and Anisotropic filtering cost GPU time and video memory that weaker graphics can't spare. | set vanilla.textureFiltering 2 -> 0
set:vanilla.enableVsync | SETTING | LOW | ticked | VSync: Off → On | On battery, VSync stops the GPU drawing frames your screen can't show, which saves power. | set vanilla.enableVsync false -> true
set:vanilla.weatherRadius | SETTING | LOW | ticked | Weather Effect Radius: 10 → 5 | A smaller weather radius draws less rain and snow around you. | set vanilla.weatherRadius 10 -> 5
advice:laptop-gpu-choice | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Check which graphics chip Minecraft uses | Minecraft is running on integrated graphics. If this laptop also has a dedicated graphics card, set Java (javaw.exe) to High performance in Windows Settings > System > Display > Graphics, then restart the game. | none
advice:battery | ADVICE | MEDIUM | unticked | Running on battery | Laptops slow down the CPU and GPU on battery to save power, so expect lower FPS. Plug in for full performance, or keep RigTune's battery-saving settings. | none
